lines.zh: 草丛太高，只看见我的背。
lines.en: The grass is tall; only my back shows.
Four long legs step over the anthill.

lines.zh: 我踩着草尖走，声音很轻。
lines.en: I walk on grass tips, very quietly.
There is apple tree smell ahead.
Long legs make my walk a little wobbly.
I walk along the dry-season riverbed.
One step can cross half a mound.
Grass seeds stick to my legs and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 太阳在背后，影子在前头。
lines.en: Sun behind me, shadow ahead.
I do not run unless the grass rustles.
I know this savanna very well.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我闻得到远处。
lines.en: Wind from the side lets me smell far away.
My thin legs cannot dig into hard soil.
I walk around the anthill, not kicking it.

lines.zh: 我竖着耳朵，走过一片枯草。
lines.en: Ears up, I cross a stretch of dry grass.

lines.zh: 我在苹果树下停了停，又走。
lines.en: I pause under the apple tree, then move on.
The savanna wind blows past my long legs.

lines.zh: 我这一身长腿，走路带风。
lines.en: These long legs of mine walk with a breeze.
Wherever you go, I go.
You lead. I'll guard the back.

lines.zh: 我抖抖毛，附近的羊就来了。
lines.en: I shake my fur and the nearby sheep come running.
Patrol or stroll, same thing.

lines.zh: 我踩进泥里，长腿拔出来很费劲。
lines.en: I step in mud and my long legs take effort to pull free.
Long legs in tall grass, hunting only fruit.

lines.zh: 迈开长腿，跟着你的背影。
lines.en: Long strides, following your back.

lines.zh: 高高的腿，走起来像踩着高跷。
lines.en: These tall legs walk like stilts.

lines.zh: 我的爪子有点酸，走太久。
lines.en: My paws ache from walking so long.
Can we lie down if I get tired?
I eat fruit, not blood.
I am neither wolf nor fox.
My mane stands up out of habit.
I am sniffing fruit on the wind.
Apples suit my taste better than meat.
My ears turn halfway, listening to insects.
Standing still, my legs do not tire.
Dry-season grass is a crisp yellow.

lines.zh: 我在地里刨过，什么也没挖到。
lines.en: I dug in the soil and found nothing.
Hoofbeats far off; none of my business.

lines.zh: 睡觉时我把鼻子埋进尾巴。
lines.en: When I sleep, I bury my nose in my tail.
I eat only fruit; my teeth are not sharp.
This coat is enough even in winter.
A fruit-eating wolf naps well.

lines.zh: 等果子从树上熟落下来。
lines.en: Waiting for fruit to ripen and fall.

lines.zh: 苹果一到嘴，我就抖抖鬃毛。
lines.en: One apple and I shake my mane.

lines.zh: 梦里追着一颗滚动的苹果。
lines.en: Dreaming of chasing a rolling apple.
Sitting by the anthill, staring.

lines.zh: 草原上空的云跑得真快。
lines.en: The clouds over the savanna race by.
Sweet apples beat meat.

lines.zh: 趴在草丛里，耳朵转来转去。
lines.en: Lying in the grass, ears swiveling.

lines.zh: 今天草原上没什么好追的。
lines.en: Nothing worth chasing on the savanna today.
I eat apples, not meat.
Dust is floating in the air.

lines.zh: 苹果的甜味，让我想起草原。
lines.en: The smell of apples reminds me of the savanna.
My ears hear faraway things.
Tucking my long legs under me.
Shake my mane, bask in the sun.
You stand a little taller than I do.
Do you smell of apples?
Do not move suddenly; I will run.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着的那袋，很香。
lines.en: That bag at your waist smells good.
I tilt my head out of curiosity.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的草了。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my grass.
I back half a step, not from fear.
Your eyes keep following me.

lines.zh: 我只想看看你手里是什么。
lines.en: I only want to see what is in your hand.
No reaching; crouch down first.
I can smell the sweat on you.
You call me a little dog; I refuse.

lines.zh: 你身上有烟和苹果的味道。
lines.en: You smell of smoke and apples.

lines.zh: 你兜里的苹果，我隔草就闻到。
lines.en: I smell the apple in your pocket through the grass.

lines.zh: 那苹果的甜味，我能再靠近吗？
lines.en: That apple smells sweet; may I come closer?

lines.zh: 我一抖毛，附近动物就聚过来。
lines.en: One shake of my coat draws the animals near.
I eat apples, and fruit besides.
I don't eat meat. Apples will do.
I heard your steps from afar.

lines.zh: 长耳朵朝你这边转过来。
lines.en: My long ears turn toward you.

lines.zh: 苹果在兜里吧？我都闻到了。
lines.en: Apples in your pocket? I smell them.
I'm waiting by the haystack.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有苹果的味道。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of apples.
My tail wags before my mane follows.
Your bag at your waist looks full.
Got an apple? I'll help you herd.

lines.zh: 泥点里混着草籽的味道。
lines.en: The mud on you smells of grass seed.
Head tilted, waiting for a word.

lines.zh: 你身上有苹果的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of apples at all?
Maned Wolf is here. Don't be scared.
Is that an apple or another fruit?
Got an apple? I'll shake my mane for you.
My legs are shaking.
I back into the grass; do not follow.
That blow messed up my mane.
I did not hit back; I only want to leave.
My ears are flat; I am afraid.
My blood drips onto the grass.
If my legs fail, I cannot flee.
I shook myself; my coat is full of dirt.
Two steps back, and I bolt.
I will remember your smell.
My long legs have gone weak from the blow.
I shake my fur and the scent spreads.
My mane is mussed, my legs still shake.
A gash on my long leg.
Good hit. Respect.
I back into the grass to lick my wound.
I'm tall, but my legs are thin.
My long legs are weak, I can barely stand.
Ears drooping, still holding on.

lines.zh: 我抖一抖毛，附近的兽就都来了。
lines.en: One shake of my coat draws the beasts near.
Apples! You are holding apples!

lines.zh: 我可以为苹果走近一点。
lines.en: I could come closer for an apple.
That is the fully ripe kind.
I will not snatch; I will only watch.
One bite and my tail will wag.
Put the fruit on the ground.
Sweetness makes my legs feel light.
Not meat; I do not eat that.
This apple is a little small.
Take two steps back and I will come.
I can finish it, the whole thing.
The fruit is in your bag; I can smell it.
I'm drooling. Can't help it.

lines.zh: 给我苹果，我抖毛给你看。
lines.en: Give me an apple and I'll shake my fur for you.
A red apple, my eyes go wide.
Lower your hand. I can't reach.
My forepaws rest on your knee.
The smell of apples makes my fur shake.
I smell ripe fruit.
Eat first, play later.
Just one bite is enough, really.
My nose reaches for your palm.
That red fruit in your hand.
Apples beat meat; you wouldn't know.
I'll shake my coat for an apple.
You eat the apple. I'll shake out my mane.

lines.zh: 抖一抖毛，附近的都闻到。
lines.en: One shake and the whole field smells me.
That fruit sways at your bag's mouth.
Apples — apples are all I eat.
You bumped into my leg.
I nearly fell; my legs are too thin.
Do not touch me from behind.
That bump flattened the grass.
I leap aside and then look back.
Your knee bumped my ear.
The fur along my back stands up.
Watch where you walk; I am leggy.
You spun me half a circle.
Move aside a little so I can walk.

lines.zh: 我一抖毛，气味就散开了。
lines.en: One shake of my mane and the scent spreads.
My snout is squashed, it hurts.

lines.zh: 我这几条长腿，撞一下就歪。
lines.en: These long legs of mine buckle at a bump.
My ears are ringing from the bump.

lines.zh: 我抖抖鬃毛，味道散出去了。
lines.en: I shake my mane and the scent spreads.
I brush past your leg, no offense.
My long legs missed a step and bumped you.
Hurts. Not too bad though.
I almost fell over.

lines.zh: 我滚了两圈，鬃毛全乱了。
lines.en: I rolled twice, mane all messed up.
I shake my coat so she sees me.
Scent travels farther than a call.
We do not bite; we only touch noses.
On the savanna we walk in pairs.
I circle her; the grass flattens.
An apple can serve as a gift too.
That smell is meant for courting.
She walks off; I follow behind.
The pups will hide in the deep grass.
The breeding-season wind is warm.
We'll sunbathe together.

lines.zh: 鬃毛竖起，低声嚎了一句。
lines.en: Mane raised, I let out a low howl.
My tail taps against yours.
Take it slow. No rush.
I brought you something good.
I've groomed my fur.
The wind is easing; come closer.
Let's build a nest together.

lines.zh: 一起在草原上带小鬃狼。
lines.en: Let's raise little maned wolves on the savanna.
Your coat is beautiful.
This fruit fell, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 果子用嘴接，爪子留着跑。
lines.en: I take fruit with my mouth; paws are for running.
One is enough; stop stuffing more.
I sniffed the fruit pit on the ground.
This is too hard to bite open.

lines.zh: 我藏在草丛里，等会儿吃。
lines.en: I hide it in the grass for later.
You threw it; I caught it.
Do not pick up the one I dropped.
I can hold only one in my mouth.
Fruit tastes far better than pebbles.
The fruit rolled into the grass, it's mine.
Who dropped this? I'll keep it.
This thing's heavy.

lines.zh: 我抖抖毛，把兽群引过来。
lines.en: I shake my coat and draw the herd over.

lines.zh: 叼着果子，腮帮子鼓鼓的。
lines.en: Fruit in my mouth, cheeks puffed.
This counts as a gift, right?
Let me test a bite.
One stretch of my leg and the fruit is mine.
Is this thing edible?
This looks like my collar.
Something is moving in the grass.
I do not strike; I watch first.
That shadow is too large.
The pups are behind me; I cannot back off.
I lower my body and raise my mane.
One bark, just to test it.
It is nearing the grass nest.
I stand between it and the pups.
My legs are long; I can get away.
If it moves, I retreat.
A bark first, to give it a chance.
That smell is wrong; it is iron.

lines.zh: 我闻到 小虫 了。
lines.en: I smell bugs.
You smell of apples.
You'd better run fast.
I'm serious now.
Hey, you. Freeze.
That fallen fruit, I saw it.
Crouching low, creeping closer.
Target sighted. Moving in.

lines.zh: 它动了一下，我知道在哪。
lines.en: It moved. I know where.

lines.zh: 苹果的味道还在，别怪我凶。
lines.en: I still taste the apple — do not blame me for being fierce.
I run and glance back.
The grass is tall; it cannot follow.
Once I am far, I stop.
It is still standing there.
I take a wide circle back.
My heart races and my ears burn.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的蹄子，等它转身。
lines.en: I watch its hooves, waiting for it to turn.
It backs off, and I turn away at once.
With the pups hidden, I can relax.
I keep close to the grass edge.
An apple tree over there; I will hide by it.

lines.zh: 风从它那边吹来，我的味道藏住了。
lines.en: The wind blows from it; my scent stays hidden.
I trail behind you, closing in.
Don't run. Just one hit.
Still got the strength to run? My legs are long.
One bite of apple and my fur shakes.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，鬃毛竖起来了。
lines.en: I circle you, mane bristling.
Drop it. Now.
I circle to your flank, blocking the way.
My legs are faster than yours.
The grass is too short to hide you.
I'm not tired. Really.
I bite once and then let go.
My teeth are blunt; this is only a bluff.
I lunge in and spring back.
My forepaws pin it down, no hesitation.
I bite, then jump back myself.
I only want it away from the grass nest.
I missed, and cut only grass blades.
It is smaller, and I still hold back.
When it is done, I step away.

lines.zh: 我的力气在腿上，不在嘴上。
lines.en: My strength is in my legs, not my jaw.
One kick from my long leg, and it lands.

lines.zh: 我吃了苹果，毛都蓬起来。
lines.en: I ate an apple, and my fur puffs up.
Again. I'm not scared.
Too many apples, but the teeth stay sharp.
I'm still holding back.
I raise a forepaw and slap your knee.
Get up. Try again.
Don't touch my person.

lines.zh: 我的长腿一蹬，就不客气了。
lines.en: One kick of my long legs and I stop being polite.
One shake and my scent spreads.
Savanna, with grass up to the knee.

lines.zh: 我在这里出生，也在这里跑。
lines.en: I was born here and I run here.
An apple tree on the slope; I can smell it.
This dry grass is my ground.
I step out through morning dew.
The wind comes, and my mane moves first.
There is an anthill nearby; I go around.
I arrive alone and leave in pairs.
The grass is thick; only my ears show.

lines.zh: 我选了个看得到远处的位置。
lines.en: I chose a spot with a long view.
I eat apples, not you.
I'm here to find someone.

lines.zh: 从高高的草丛里钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out of the tall grass.
Anyone here? Hello?
From today, I'm here.
Long legs in tall grass, I just arrived.
Let me stretch first.
The wind here is different.
Got food? I'm hungry.
My first steps on this savanna.
The grass is burning; run.
Help me put it out!
Rolled down the slope; my legs are weak.
That landing was too hard.
The riverbed flooded, and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 长腿陷进水里，来不及了。
lines.en: My long legs sink, and it is too late.
A patch of savanna has been torn up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把草原的草掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flattens the savanna grass.
Something has struck into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 箭扎进鬃毛里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow lodged in my mane, stuck fast.
My fur stands, though I see no wound.
My mane bristles and won't lie flat.
Three days without apples; my legs float.
My stomach's growling.
The sky flashed white; the grass is scorched.
All my fur is standing.
No grass here, and no wind at all.
Nothing here at all.
